page.title: Teams
page.subtitle: Manage teams, members, and their access to models and budgets

hint.models: Leave empty to grant no models directly. The team keeps any models granted through its access groups
hint.modelAliases: Map a custom alias to an underlying model. Team members can call the alias in API requests instead of the real model name.
hint.softBudgetAlertingEmails: Comma-separated email addresses to receive alerts when the soft budget is reached
hint.teamMemberSettings: Optional defaults applied when members join this team. All fields can be overridden per member.
hint.teamMemberSettingsTooltip: These are limits on individual team members
hint.defaultModelAccess: Optional. If set, new members can only access these models by default. Must be a subset of the team's models above. Leave empty to give all members access to all team models.
hint.defaultBudget: Default spend budget for each member in this team.
hint.defaultKeyDuration: Set a limit to the duration of a team member's key. Format: 30s (seconds), 30m (minutes), 30h (hours), 30d (days), 1mo (month)
hint.defaultTpmLimit: Default tokens per minute limit for each member. Can be overridden per member.
hint.defaultRpmLimit: Default requests per minute limit for each member. Can be overridden per member.
hint.metadata: Values are saved as text. Enter JSON for typed values, e.g. 3, true, or {"region": "us"}.
hint.modelSpecificRateLimits: Set per-model TPM/RPM limits that apply across the whole team.
hint.guardrails: Select which guardrails apply to this team. Global guardrails are enabled by default, uncheck to opt out. Other guardrails are opt-in.
hint.disableGlobalGuardrails: Kill switch: bypass every global guardrail for this team, including any added in the future. For per-guardrail opt-out instead, use the Guardrails dropdown above.
hint.policies: Apply policies to this team to control guardrails and other settings
hint.accessGroups: Assign access groups to this team. Access groups control which models, MCP servers, and agents this team can use
hint.passThroughPremium: Premium feature - Upgrade to set allowed pass through routes
hint.passThroughProxyAdmin: Only proxy admins can set allowed pass through routes
hint.allowedSearchTools: Select which search tools this team can access. Leave empty to allow all search tools.
hint.skills: Enabled skills are visible to every team. Grant disabled (private) Claude Code plugins to this team here.
hint.secretManagerSettings: Enter secret manager configuration as a JSON object.
hint.secretManagerSettingsPremium: Premium feature - Upgrade to manage secret manager settings.

placeholder.defaultModelAccess: Leave empty — all team models accessible to every member
placeholder.mcpServersAndGroups: Select MCP servers or access groups (optional)
placeholder.searchTools: Select search tools (optional, empty = all allowed)

create.title: Create Team
create.organizationHint: Organizations can have multiple teams. Learn more about the user management hierarchy
create.singleOrganizationHint: You can only create teams within this organization
create.selectOrganizationNotice: Please select an organization to create a team for. You can only create teams within organizations where you are an admin.
create.modelsHint: These are the models that your selected team has access to. Leave empty to grant no models directly, e.g. when the team gets its models from access groups
create.teamIdHint: ID of the team you want to create. If not provided, it will be generated automatically.
create.guardrailsDescription: Select existing guardrails or enter new ones
create.disableGlobalGuardrailsDescription: Bypass global guardrails for this team
create.disableGlobalGuardrailsPremium: Premium feature - Upgrade to disable global guardrails by team
create.policiesDescription: Select existing policies or enter new ones
create.accessGroupsDescription: Select access groups to assign to this team
create.allowedVectorStoresDescription: Select vector stores this team can access. Leave empty for access to all vector stores
create.allowedMcpServersDescription: Select MCP servers or access groups this team can access
create.allowedAgentsDescription: Select agents or access groups this team can access
create.allowedSearchToolsDescription: Restrict which configured search tools keys on this team may call.
create.allowedSkillsDescription: Private skills keys on this team may see in the Claude Code marketplace.
create.modelAliasesDescription: Create custom aliases for models that can be used by team members in API calls. This allows you to create shortcuts for specific models.

hint.teamMemberBudget: This is the individual budget for a user in the team.
hint.teamMemberRpmLimit: The RPM (Requests Per Minute) limit for individual team members
hint.teamMemberTpmLimit: The TPM (Tokens Per Minute) limit for individual team members
hint.disableGlobalGuardrails: When enabled, this team will bypass any guardrails configured to run on every request (global guardrails)
hint.allowedVectorStores: Select which vector stores this team can access by default. Leave empty for access to all vector stores
hint.allowedMcpServers: Select which MCP servers or access groups this team can access
hint.allowedAgents: Select which agents or access groups this team can access

delete.teamWarning: Warning: This team has {{keyCount}} keys associated with it. Deleting the team will also delete all associated keys, along with any models created for this team. This action is irreversible.
delete.teamMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this team, all its keys, and any models created for it? This action cannot be undone.
delete.memberAlert: Removing team members will also delete any keys created by or created for this member.
delete.memberMessage: Are you sure you want to remove this member from the team? This action cannot be undone.

member.budgetTooltip: Maximum amount in USD this member can spend within this team. This is separate from any global user budget limits
member.budgetPlaceholder: Budget limit for this member within this team
member.budgetResetTooltip: How often this member's budget resets within the team. Leave unset and the budget never resets.
member.tpmTooltip: Maximum tokens per minute this member can use within this team. This is separate from any global user TPM limit
member.tpmPlaceholder: Tokens per minute limit for this member in this team
member.rpmTooltip: Maximum requests per minute this member can make within this team. This is separate from any global user RPM limit
member.rpmPlaceholder: Requests per minute limit for this member in this team
member.allowedModelsTooltip: Models this member can access within this team. Leave empty to inherit all team models.
member.allowedModelsPlaceholder: Leave empty to inherit all team models

validation.modelRateLimitRequired: Set at least one of TPM or RPM
validation.organizationNotAllowed: You can no longer create teams in this organization
